title: Savoy Cabbage Amatriciana
description: A creative Italian-inspired oven-baked dish featuring roasted savoy cabbage and amatriciana sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss cabbage with olive oil, garlic, and Italian seasoning until evenly coated.
Transfer the cabbage mixture to a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized.
While the cabbage is roasting, heat the amatriciana sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
Once the cabbage is done, remove from the oven and toss with the heated amatriciana sauce.
Transfer the cabbage mixture to a serving dish and sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.
